truth_claims.note: conf=0.82; Short story (~2010, Subterranean Press, posted on Scalzi's Whatever blog; ebook edition Jan 2012, also sold as "An Election Story" on Kobo). Set in the "Third District" — Goodreads lists a 2-book Third District series: An Election (2010, #1) and Constituent Service (2024/2025, #2, an indirect sequel). The numbering is by publication order per Goodreads; the story itself was not marketed as a numbered volume when first released.

truth_claims.title: An Election
truth_claims.author: John Scalzi
truth_claims.note: conf=0.85; Verified: "An Election" is a standalone humorous short story by John Scalzi, presented by Subterranean Press/Subterranean Online and published free on Scalzi's blog Whatever on November 1, 2010 (an election-themed piece released ahead of the US midterms). Scalzi's own "Creative Sampler" page lists it as a standalone short story, not as part of any book series. Plot: a human runs for city council in a district where humans are a minority among aliens. It is NOT part of Old Man's War, and although some reader reviews note a tonal similarity to The Android's Dream (and one Goodreads reviewer loosely calls it the "Third District universe"), no publisher or bibliographic source identifies a real named series containing this title. Therefore series = null. Author metadata "Scalzi" expanded to John Scalzi.
